title: Tenses
description: 137 multiple-choice questions about English tenses and related grammar topics, split into 6 parts in the quiz UI.

questions.text: This word ... wrongly.
questions.explanation: Câu bị động với trạng từ 'wrongly' dùng 'is spelt'.

questions.text: The story I've just read ... Jack London.
questions.explanation: Bị động đúng dạng là 'was written by'.

questions.text: I'm going to go out and .......
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc 'have something done' là 'have my hair cut'.

questions.text: The man died because medical help was not summoned. A doctor should ...
questions.explanation: 'should have been called' là bị động hoàn thành.

questions.text: Something funny ... in class yesterday.
questions.explanation: 'yesterday' chỉ quá khứ đơn, 'happen' không dùng ở dạng bị động ở đây.

questions.text: We ... by a loud noise during the night.
questions.explanation: Bị động quá khứ: 'were woken up'.

questions.text: Some film stars ... difficult to work with.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc 'be said to be'.

questions.text: People say that some Americans are superficially friendly.
options: A. Some Americans are said as being superficially friendly.
B. Some Americans are said that they are superficially friendly.
C. People are said that some Americans are superficially friendly.
D. Some Americans are said to be superficially friendly.
questions.explanation: Câu tường thuật bị động: 'Some Americans are said to be ...'

questions.text: I still can't believe it. My bicycle ... last night.
questions.explanation: Bị động quá khứ: 'was stolen'.

questions.text: John ... last week.
options: C. had his father to paint
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc 'have something done': 'had his house painted'.

questions.text: It is believed that he is the richest man in the city.
options: A. He was believed to be the richest man in the city.
B. He is believed to be the richest man in the city.
C. They believe that he is the richest man in the city.
D. B and C are correct.
questions.explanation: Cả B và C đều đúng nghĩa của câu gốc.

questions.text: I can’t go along here because the road ...
questions.explanation: 'is being repaired' diễn tả hành động đang được thực hiện.

questions.text: ... about the eight o’clock flight to Chicago?
options: A. Has been an announcement made
C. Has an announcement been made
D. Has been made an announcement
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi bị động đúng là 'Has an announcement been made?'.

questions.text: Do you get your heating ... every year?
questions.explanation: 'get something done' -> 'get your heating checked'.

questions.text: Why did Tom keep making jokes about me? I don't enjoy ... at.
questions.explanation: Sau 'enjoy' dùng V-ing: 'being laughed at'.

questions.text: Claude Jennings is said ... his memory.
questions.explanation: 'is said to have lost' diễn tả việc đã xảy ra trước đó.

questions.text: I might watch this programme. It ... very funny.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc 'be supposed to be'.

questions.text: Today, many serious childhood diseases ... by early immunization.
questions.explanation: Câu bị động với modal verb: 'can be prevented'.

questions.text: The boys were punished ... they made many mistakes.
questions.explanation: Phạt vì họ mắc nhiều lỗi nên dùng 'because'.

questions.text: ... the liberation of women, women can take part in social activities.
questions.explanation: 'Thanks to' nghĩa là nhờ vào.

questions.text: Despite feeling cold, we kept walking.
options: A. Although we felt cold, but we kept walking
B. Although we felt cold, we kept walking
C. However cold we felt, but we kept walking
D. However we felt cold, we kept walking
questions.explanation: 'Despite + V-ing' tương đương 'Although + clause'.

questions.text: She decided to leave her job in the company ... she could earn a lot of money there.
questions.explanation: Ý đối lập, cô ấy rời công ty mặc dù có thể kiếm nhiều tiền.

questions.text: The children laughed a lot because of the funny story.
options: A. The children laughed because the story is funny.
B. The children laughed because of the story funny.
C. The children laughed because it was funny.
D. The children laughed because the story was funny.
questions.explanation: Chuyển 'because of + noun phrase' sang mệnh đề 'because the story was funny'.

questions.text: Although he took a taxi, Bill still arrived late for the concert.
options: A. Bill arrived late for the concert because he takes a taxi.
B. Bill arrived late for the concert because of the taxi.
C. In spite of taking a taxi, Bill arrived late for the concert.
D. Although Bill took a taxi he can’t come to the concert on time.
questions.explanation: 'Although' có thể đổi thành 'In spite of + V-ing'.

questions.text: The flight was delayed ... the fog.
questions.explanation: 'because of the fog' diễn tả nguyên nhân.

questions.text: She was so busy that she couldn't answer the phone.
options: A. She was very busy so that she couldn't answer the phone.
B. She was too busy to answer the phone.
C. She was too busy not to answer the phone.
D. She was very busy so that she could answer the phone.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc 'too + adjective + to V' diễn tả quá ... đến nỗi không thể làm gì.

questions.text: It was ... that we went for a hike in the mountains.
questions.explanation: 'Such a/an + adjective + noun' dùng với danh từ đếm được số ít.

questions.text: There are ... in the universe that we can not count them.
questions.explanation: 'Stars' là danh từ số nhiều nên dùng 'so many'.

questions.text: He has ... to do that he can't go to the cinema with us.
questions.explanation: 'Work' là danh từ không đếm được nên dùng 'so much'.

questions.text: Faraday's father was ... poor to send him to school.
questions.explanation: 'Too + adjective + to V' là cấu trúc chuẩn ở đây.

questions.text: It is ... book that just a few people like it.
questions.explanation: 'Such an old book' đúng vì 'book' là danh từ đếm được số ít.

questions.text: He spoke too ... for us to understand.
questions.explanation: Sau 'spoke' cần trạng từ, nên dùng 'quickly'.

questions.text: She came too late to see off, or we can say:
options: A. She came so late to see him off.
B. She didn't come early enough to see him off.
C. She came early enough to see him off.
D. She didn't come late enough to see him off.
questions.explanation: 'Too late to...' nghĩa là 'không đủ sớm để...'.

questions.text: Which sentence is correct?
options: A. It was such a hot tea that I couldn't drink it.
B. It was such hot tea that I couldn't drink.
C. Tea wasn't too hot to drink.
D. Tea was so hot that I couldn't drink it.
questions.explanation: 'So + adjective + that' diễn tả kết quả phù hợp nhất.

questions.text: Nobody could move the piano. It was too heavy.
options: A. The piano was so heavy that nobody couldn't move.
B. The piano was too heavy to move.
C. It was such a heavy piano that nobody could move it.
D. It was such heavy piano that nobody could move it.
questions.explanation: 'Too heavy to move' là cách viết gọn và tự nhiên nhất.

questions.text: She locked the door ... .
options: A. so that to go to bed
B. in order to be disturbed
D. in order not to be disturbed
questions.explanation: 'in order not to + V' dùng để chỉ mục đích tránh bị làm phiền.

questions.text: The boy always does his homework before class ... .
options: A. so as not to be punished by the teacher
B. so as to be punished by the teacher
C. so that he will be punished by the teacher
D. in order to be punished by the teacher
questions.explanation: Cậu bé làm bài để tránh bị phạt nên dùng dạng phủ định của mục đích.

questions.text: I got up early in order not to be late for school.
options: A. I got up early so as not to being late for school.
B. I got up early so that I won't be late for school.
C. I got up early so that I wouldn't be late for school.
D. I got up early for me not to be late for school.
questions.explanation: 'in order not to' ở quá khứ đổi thành 'so that I wouldn't ...'.

questions.text: They whispered. They didn't want anyone to hear them.
options: A. They whispered to make anyone hear them.
B. They whispered so that no one could hear them.
C. They whispered so that everyone could hear them.
D. They whispered in order not to hear them.
questions.explanation: 'so that no one could hear them' diễn tả mục đích đúng nghĩa.

questions.text: He wore glasses and false beard so that no one could recognize him.
options: A. He wore glasses and the false beard in order not to recognize him.
B. He wore glasses and the false beard in order to recognize him.
C. He wore glasses and the false beard in order to be recognized.
D. He wore glasses and the false beard in order not to be recognized.
questions.explanation: Dùng bị động trong cụm mục đích: 'in order not to be recognized'.

questions.text: I try to learn English well. I want to get a good job.
options: A. I try to study English well so that I can get a good job.
B. I try to study English well so as I can get a good job.
C. So that I can get a good job, I try to study English well.
D. I try to study English well for me to get a good job.
questions.explanation: 'so that I can get a good job' là cách nối hai ý đúng ngữ pháp nhất.

questions.text: You may put money in a small coin bank ... .
options: A. in order to keep it safe
B. so as not to keep it safe
C. so that to keep it safe
questions.explanation: 'in order to + V' chỉ mục đích.

questions.text: The schoolboys are in a hurry ... they will not be for the meeting.
questions.explanation: 'in order that + clause' diễn tả mục đích đi kèm mệnh đề.

questions.text: Are we lost? I think so. I wish we ... a map with us today.
questions.explanation: 'I wish' + quá khứ hoàn thành dùng cho điều ước trái với quá khứ.

questions.text: These figures are too complicated to work out in your head. Yes, ... a calculator.
options: A. I wish we would have
C. if only we had had
questions.explanation: 'If only we had a calculator' diễn tả điều ước ở hiện tại.

questions.text: If Jake ... to go on the trip, would you have gone?
questions.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 3 dùng 'hadn't agreed' trong mệnh đề if.

questions.text: If energy ............ inexpensive and unlimited, many things in the world would be different.
questions.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 2 dùng 'were' sau 'If' với 'would' ở mệnh đề chính.

questions.text: Unless you ... all of my questions, I can't do anything to help you.

questions.text: Had you told me that this was going to happen, I ........ it.

questions.text: ........ interested in that subject, I would try to learn more about it.
questions.explanation: Đảo ngữ: 'Were I ...' tương đương 'If I were ...'.

questions.text: If I had enough money, ...............
options: A. I will buy that house
B. I am buy that house
C. I can buy that house
D. I could buy that house

questions.text: Had I had time, I .......... to the beach with you this weekend.

questions.text: If he ............. that she was in the hospital, he .......... to see her.

questions.text: If everything is all right, we ............ our work on time.

questions.text: If I were you, I would work hard.

C. You should work with me
D. Do not work so hard.

questions.text: We didn't visit the museum because we had no time.

B. If we had time, we would have visited the museum.

D. If we had had time, we will have visited the museum.

questions.text: ........... I have time, I will go with you.

questions.text: ........... harder, you would have passed the exam.
questions.explanation: Đảo ngữ câu điều kiện loại 3: 'Had you studied ...'

questions.text: If the police hadn’t saved me, I .......... at that time.

questions.text: ............ at 4 o'clock, we would have missed seeing Bob.
options: D. A and B are correct.
questions.explanation: Cả A và B đều đúng và cùng nghĩa.

questions.text: Mike is 1.7 meters tall, but Harriet is 1.8 meters.

B. Harriet is taller than Mike.
C. Mike and Harriet are both tall.
D. Mike is as tall as Harriet.
questions.explanation: Harriet cao 1.8m, Mike 1.7m nên Harriet cao hơn.

questions.text: You and Luke are both better than ---------.

questions.text: It is becoming -------- for me to keep up.

questions.text: The lesson is difficult. We try hard.

B. The more hard we try, the more difficult the lesson is.
C. The more difficult the lesson is, the harder we try.
D. The more difficult the lesson is and the harder we try.

questions.text: Tom is the best football player in this team.
